questions.q: Which ancient city near Tunis fought three wars with Rome?
questions.why: Rome destroyed it in 146 BC.

questions.q: Which Carthage-born general invaded Italy in 218 BC?
questions.why: He was born in Carthage.

questions.q: In which year did Tunisia gain independence from France?
questions.why: It became a republic the next year.

questions.q: Who was Tunisia's first President?
questions.why: He championed women's rights.

questions.q: Which 2010–11 revolution began the Arab Spring?
questions.why: A street vendor's protest sparked it.

questions.q: Which Tunisian group won the 2015 Nobel Peace Prize?
questions.why: It helped keep the democratic transition peaceful.

questions.q: Which Phoenician queen is said to have founded Carthage?
questions.why: She came from Tyre.

questions.q: Which 1956 law gave Tunisian women rights unusual in the region?
questions.why: It banned polygamy.

questions.q: Who ruled Tunisia from 1987 to 2011?
questions.why: He fled to Saudi Arabia in 2011.

questions.q: Which city has the oldest mosque in North Africa, the Great Mosque founded in 670?
questions.why: It is a holy city of Islam.

questions.q: Which Roman amphitheatre in El Jem is one of the largest ever built?
questions.why: It held about 35,000 people.

questions.q: Which street vendor's act set off the 2010 revolution?
questions.why: He set himself on fire in Sidi Bouzid.

questions.q: Which Fatimid capital on the coast was founded in 921?
questions.why: It was named after the caliph al-Mahdi.

questions.q: Which Tunis-born scholar wrote the 'Muqaddimah'?
questions.why: He is seen as a founder of sociology.

questions.q: Which Roman town with a hilltop Capitol is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It is well preserved.

questions.q: What is the capital of Tunisia?
questions.why: Its medina is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which white-and-blue village near Tunis is famous for its views?
questions.why: Artists like Paul Klee painted there.

questions.q: Which spicy chilli paste is a Tunisian staple?
questions.why: It is on UNESCO's heritage list.

questions.q: What is Tunisia's currency?
questions.why: Its code is TND.

questions.q: Which large island in the south is a popular holiday spot?
questions.why: It has one of the oldest synagogues in Africa.

questions.q: Which film series used southern Tunisia as the planet Tatooine?
questions.why: The village of Matmata hosted Luke's home.

questions.q: Which sea lies along Tunisia's coast?
questions.why: It has over 1,000 km of coastline.

questions.q: Which egg-in-pastry snack is a Tunisian favourite?
questions.why: It is fried and often filled with tuna.

questions.q: Which salt lake in the south is the largest in the Sahara?
questions.why: Mirages often appear over it.

questions.q: Which tennis player became the first Arab woman to reach a Grand Slam final?
questions.why: She reached Wimbledon finals in 2022 and 2023.

questions.q: Which Tunisian swimmer won Olympic 1,500 m gold in 2008?
questions.why: He also won 10 km open-water gold in 2012.

questions.q: Which musical tradition came from Andalusia to Tunisia?
questions.why: It is played with oud and violin.

questions.q: Which diamond-shaped semolina pastry filled with dates comes from Kairouan?
questions.why: They are fried and soaked in syrup.

questions.q: Which national park around a lake is a UNESCO site for birds?
questions.why: Hundreds of thousands of birds winter there.

questions.q: Which underground homes in Matmata were carved by Berbers?
questions.why: Rooms open onto a deep circular courtyard.
